verdict.rationale: Fellow documents workspace-wide bulk data handling: the Super Admin API can retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace (fellow-docs-47, fellow-docs-71). It also offers multi-item listing, such as list endpoints with cursor pagination and a list-uploads view for monitoring many recordings at once (fellow-docs-33, fellow-docs-64). However, every documented mutation (complete or archive an action item, edit an agenda, delete a note) acts on one item at a time, so bulk changes appear to require looping over single calls. missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk write endpoints, bulk updates for action items or notes, bulk operations exposed through MCP or the UI, Enterprise-only gating of the bulk export/delete, independent or hands-on corroboration.
